summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of its own Class XXX Notes (YMCWO) between June 8 and June 12, 2026. The repurchase totaled ARS 21,436,150,457.80 (par value US$14,924,000) at an average price of 99.93% of nominal value. The notes were originally issued under YPF's Frequent Issuer framework with maturity in July 2026. The repurchased notes will be held in portfolio. This is a routine debt management action, not a special situation. There is no change of control, no activist campaign, no strategic review, and no tender offer for equity securities.
